proposed_widenings.name: SavingThrowSourceFilter { kind: "creature_breath_weapon"; creatureType?: CreatureType }
proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants Advantage specifically on saving throws against breath weapons of Dragons, not against all Dragon attacks or all magical effects. The existing `attackerTypeFilter` on `modify_roll_advantage` is too broad (covers any save vs a dragon), and `SavingThrowSourceFilter` only has `spell_or_other_magical_effect` which doesn't apply to non-spell breath weapons. A new variant scoped to breath-weapon saves is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Advantage on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons

proposed_widenings.name: detect property: { kind: "creature_of_type"; creatureType: CreatureType } with range in miles
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation ability detects the closest dragon of the same type as the armor within 30 miles, returning both distance and direction. The existing `detect` atom only supports four fixed properties (magic, evil_and_good, poison_and_disease, thoughts) and measures radius in feet. A new property variant scoped to creature type is needed, and the range unit should support miles (or a very large foot count is workable but semantically wrong).
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can focus your senses as a Magic action to discern the distance and direction to the closest dragon within 30 miles of yourself that is of the same type as the armor

notes: The item would naturally encode as a collection record with 10 variants (one per dragon color/type from the table), each having a fixed damage resistance. The passive +1 AC and per-variant resistance both encode cleanly. The composite mechanics structure (passive + activated ability) exists. Two widenings block honest encoding: (1) SavingThrowSourceFilter needs a breath_weapon variant for the advantage rider, and (2) the detect atom needs a creature-type property and optionally a miles-range unit. The breath weapon advantage is a primary passive grant, not a secondary rider, so encoding only the clean mechanics (AC, resistance) while omitting it would produce a misleadingly incomplete trace.
